Question: How has the government of Delcy Rodriguez responded to this disaster?

#Venezuela opposition leader @dsmolansky: “No response, Jim. There's no response. It is the closest to a failed state…the armed forces have completely disappeared - the same armed forces that have been used several times to repress the innocent.”

posts.text:
Natural disasters test governments perhaps more than any other crisis and the government response so far undermines the US claim all is well post-Maduro.


The Associated Press (@AP)

AP's Juan Arraez was in Venezuela when a devastating double earthquake ravaged the country on Wednesday. Today, he captured footage of citizens digging through the rubble of their homes, saying they have seen few state rescue teams in the areas hit hardest by the devastating 7.2 and 7.5 magnitude quakes.
AP Video/J
